title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The response must clearly state the conditions under which interference effects are observed or not observed.

title: Coherence Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The response should explain the significance of coherence in observing interference effects.

title: Response Time
description: Important Criteria: The response must mention the importance of the response time of human sense organs in sensing interference.

title: Power Comparison
description: Important Criteria: The response should discuss the need for comparable power levels of the generators for interference to be sensed.

title: Common Emitters
description: Optional Criteria: The response may include examples of common light and sound emitters that typically do not produce observable interference.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The response should avoid stating that interference effects are always observable without the conditions being met.
